description: This file defines the `ExtensionSet` class in the Twig templating engine. It manages collections of extensions, filters, functions, tests, node visitors, token parsers, and operators, handling their initialization, registration, and retrieval within the Twig environment.

classes.name: Twig\ExtensionSet
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing a collection of Twig extensions, including filters, functions, tests, token parsers, node visitors, and operators. It handles the lifecycle and dependency injection for these components.

methods.name: initRuntime
methods.description: Initializes the runtime environment for Twig extensions.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is registered.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a registered extension by its class name.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Registers multiple extensions at once.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns all registered extensions.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representing the signature of the registered extensions.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the extensions have been initialized.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last modification based on extension files.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds a new extension to the set.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Registers a new Twig function.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Retrieves all registered functions.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a function by name, supporting dynamic matching.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFunctionCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to handle undefined functions.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Registers a new filter.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves all registered filters.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a filter by name, supporting dynamic matching.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFilterCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to handle undefined filters.

methods.name: addNodeVisitor
methods.description: Adds a node visitor for traversing AST nodes during compilation.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns all registered node visitors.

methods.name: addTokenParser
methods.description: Adds a token parser to handle custom tags.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Retrieves all token parsers.

methods.name: getTokenParser
methods.description: Retrieves a token parser by name.

methods.name: registerUndefinedTokenParserCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for handling undefined token parsers.

methods.name: getGlobals
methods.description: Retrieves global variables provided by extensions.

methods.name: resetGlobals
methods.description: Clears cached globals.

methods.name: addTest
methods.description: Registers a new test.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Retrieves all registered tests.

methods.name: getTest
methods.description: Retrieves a test by name, supporting dynamic matching.

methods.name: getUnaryOperators
methods.description: Returns all unary operators registered by extensions.

methods.name: getBinaryOperators
methods.description: Returns all binary operators registered by extensions.
